title: JSX rules
summary: We learn the rules that make JSX different from HTML: expressions in braces, one root, attribute names such as className and htmlFor, closed tags, and conditional rendering. You will practice each rule on the Week 10 Session 1 example and finish by translating a semantic HTML card into JSX rendered from a data object.
changeNote: Rewritten so each step opens with an explainer or a prediction, folds the background under Read more, and ends with a quiz.
